sources.title: ABS Census 2021 G02: Selected medians and averages
sources.role: SA1 median weekly rent and median household income from the same census year. Their ratio is an area cost-to-income proxy, not the share of any household income spent on rent; the income median includes all households.

sources.title: City of Melbourne CLUE 2024 buildings and residential dwellings
sources.role: Property ID joins dwelling records; unique point-in-footprint links expose use, construction/refurbishment year. Ambiguous/proximity matches remain in validation, not definite attributes. No other council is assumed covered.

sources.title: Homes Victoria Rental Report, September quarter 2025
sources.role: Moving annual suburb-group and quarterly LGA flat rents by 1/2/3 bedrooms; area context only. No building-level rent was obtained. Current market rents are not divided by 2021 incomes in the score. Student housing, rooming houses and other excluded types retain an applicability warning.

model.I: 0.7 × percentile(low-income household share) + 0.3 × percentile(2021 median rent / 2021 median household income). Both are SA1 context. Missing rent/income medians prevent a complete I; no fabricated building income.
model.H: 0.7 × percentile(multi-date sun-exposed Landsat median) + 0.3 × historic heat/greenness branch. The branch uses 0.5 temperature context + 0.2 vegetation deficit + 0.3 canopy deficit. Temperature context averages relative percentiles of CSIRO UHI, Victoria 2018 UHI and Climate Victoria summer normals. CSIRO LST is the parent/evidence layer, not an extra weighted copy of its derived UHI.
model.assumptions: Exploratory screening choices, not fitted or validated impact coefficients. Percentiles have different periods and scales. Related UHI and vegetation sources are grouped into one capped historical branch, not treated as independent confirmations. The peer report inspires the 50/20/30 branch but its exact temperature input, bins and final model are not reproduced.
model.stability: 6 H/I/B choices × 3 extents × 3 recent/historical heat blends (60/40, 70/30, 80/20) = 54 tested settings; one fixed multi-date input, no date selection.
